title: Udit Narayan v. State of U.P. and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Recovery citation quashed with costs; fresh Supply Code proceedings left open.
headnote: Recovery citation dated 29.11.2021 for electricity-theft dues quashed after the licensee conceded it was wrongly issued and was being withdrawn. Respondent no. 4 may proceed afresh strictly under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Costs of Rs. 10,000 imposed.
facts: Udit Narayan challenged a recovery citation dated 29 November 2021, issued by respondent no. 4, for electricity dues in a theft case. The Allahabad High Court stayed coercive action on 26 April 2023. On 9 May 2023 counsel for the department admitted that notice of the provisional assessment had not been sent by registered post. On 15 May 2023 respondent no. 4 wrote that the citation had been wrongly issued and was being withdrawn.

holding_units.topic: quash of a wrongly issued theft-dues recovery citation
holding_units.holding: The recovery citation dated 29.11.2021 for electricity-theft dues, which the licensee conceded had been wrongly issued and was being withdrawn, is quashed. Respondent no. 4 may proceed afresh only in strict accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Respondent nos. 3 and 4 shall pay the petitioner costs of Rs. 10,000 within two weeks, and respondent no. 3 may recover that sum from the erring officer.
holding_units.flag: The order invokes the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 without a clause number. Dates 4.5.2023, 5.5.2023 and 16.5.2023 are not code clauses.

principle_tags.application: On the licensee's concession that the 29.11.2021 recovery citation for theft dues was wrongly issued and was being withdrawn, the Court quashed it, left respondent no. 4 free to proceed afresh strictly under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and imposed costs of Rs. 10,000 for the harassment.

not_decided.point: The petitioner's liability for the alleged theft, and the validity of any fresh assessment or recovery.
not_decided.note: Respondent no. 4 was left free to proceed afresh strictly under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether failure to send the provisional-assessment notice by registered post, without more, invalidates an assessment.
not_decided.note: The department admitted the omission on 9 May 2023 and then withdrew the citation. The final order does not construe that service requirement.
